::: {#def-qq-plot}
#### Normal quantile-quantile plot

A **normal quantile-quantile (Q-Q) plot** plots the sorted observations
([order statistics](nonparametric-models.qmd#def-order-statistics))
against the corresponding quantiles of a standard Gaussian distribution [@wikipedia_q_q_plot].
If the variable is approximately Gaussian,
the points fall close to a straight line.

Source: @wikipedia_q_q_plot.
:::
